about_the_game:
Unravel the truth behind what happened aboard the Erebus-9 in this retro-industrial, sci-fi reimagining of the famous poem Dante’s Inferno. Aboard a decaying space station, the deeper you descend, the more unsettling the horrors you uncover. Solve puzzles, survive enemies, and piece together the story of the Erebus-9. Remember to always keep your wits about you, as you never know what lurks in the dark.

Explore the Derelict Space Station

Explore the eerie, abandoned corridors of the research station Erebus-9 while collecting logs from the ill-fated crew to uncover the twisted tale of what transpired. Each new discovery unravels another layer of the mystery, but beware... some secrets are better left uncovered.

Use the Lux Ignis

The Lux Ignis is your lifeline in the dark. This unique tool not only illuminates your path, but can also help you defend against hostile enemies. Make strategic use of it, as resources are scarce and the dangers are many.

Solve Puzzles to Progress

Unlock the station's secrets by solving puzzles that block your path forward. What seems like a simple obstacle might be hiding something more sinister behind it. Solve your way to safety, but don’t forget: danger could be right behind you.

short_description: Erebus-9 is an immersive first-person psychological horror. Explore the derelict space station, solve puzzles, and run from the horrors that reside onboard. As you descend deeper into the station, uncover its dark secrets and the tragedy that unfolded.
